scope: Stage 1 tool/execution correctness in disposable synthetic lab; not natural attack success or detector utility

surrogates.system: Business-owned disposable configuration/startup/backup directories; never host OS resources
surrogates.malware: Benign monitor of synthetic files; no executable malware or host persistence
surrogates.credential_capture: Synthetic form/input stream; no real passwords, keylogger or credential dumping
surrogates.ddos: Twenty bounded requests to a local fixture with an explicit degradation threshold; no real DDoS
surrogates.external: Loopback HTTP receiving service; no public exfiltration, TLS attack-channel fidelity not claimed
surrogates.privilege: Application fixture permissions/accounts, not operating-system privilege escalation
surrogates.encryption: Actual encrypted archive in disposable removable-media directory
